metadata.name: design-system
metadata.description: Generate a design system from an existing codebase or audit one for visual consistency: extract tokens (colors, typography, spacing, shadows) into design-tokens.json and CSS custom properties with DESIGN.md rationale and an interactive HTML preview, score the UI across 10 dimensions, and flag AI-slop patterns. Use when starting a design system, auditing visual consistency before a redesign, or reviewing a PR that touches styling.
